English source: click one of the buttons below.||play against the computer or|against a friend!
Simplified Chinese: 选择下方按钮：\n与电脑对战，或与朋友对战！

English source: use your weapons to fire at your opponents|click and drag and then let go to throw them
Simplified Chinese: 使用武器攻击对手。\n按住并拖动，松开后投掷。

English source: click on a character and throw him to move him
Simplified Chinese: 选中角色并投掷，让他移动。

English source: no completed records yet| |defeat all 15 campaign levels|to record your high score!
Simplified Chinese: 还没有通关记录。\n完成全部十五关，留下你的最高分！

English source: Ported to Unity by Richard Xue
Click one of the options above\nto select it.
Simplified Chinese: 请选择上方的武器或操作。

English source:
Click your character and drag
with the mouse to aim and set
the power.
you get to use this once per
turn before you use a weapon.
Simplified Chinese: 按住角色并拖动，调整方向和力度。\n每回合使用武器前可以投掷一次角色。

English source: click here if you want to finish\nyour turn without using a\nweapon.
Simplified Chinese: 不使用武器，直接结束本回合。

English source: click here to cancel and select\nanother player.
Simplified Chinese: 取消当前选择，改选其他角色。

English source:
Basic weak weapon which
explodes on impact.
Click the cherry bomb and drag
with your mouse to aim and set
the power.
Simplified Chinese: 基础武器，碰撞后爆炸。\n按住炸弹并拖动，调整方向和力度。

English source:
This weapon explodes when it
comes to rest.
Click the dynamite and drag
with your mouse to aim and set
the power.
Simplified Chinese: 停止移动后爆炸。\n按住并拖动，调整方向和力度。

English source:
Large boulder which can bash
other players out of the way.
Click the boulder and drag
with your mouse to aim and set
the power.
Simplified Chinese: 巨石能撞开其他角色。\n按住并拖动，调整方向和力度。

English source:
Eight coins which inflict a small
amount of damage. You get
eight turns with this weapon.
Click each one and drag to aim
and set the power.
Simplified Chinese: 连续投出八枚金币，每枚造成少量伤害。\n逐枚拖动，调整方向和力度。

English source:
This weapon explodes on impact
and sets the nearby area on fire.
Click it and drag
with your mouse to aim and set
the power.
Simplified Chinese: 碰撞后爆炸，并点燃周围区域。\n按住并拖动，调整方向和力度。

English source:
This weapon is very bouncy.
Click and drag with the mouse
to aim and set the power.
Then click your mouse again to
make it explode.
Simplified Chinese: 弹性十足。拖动瞄准并投出，\n再次点击即可引爆。

English source:
Click and drag with the mouse
to aim and set the power.
As it drifts down use
your cursor as a fan to push it
left or right.
Simplified Chinese: 拖动瞄准并投出。下落时移动光标，\n像扇子一样推它向左或向右。

English source:
Click anywhere on the stage to
place down three crates.
use these to form a wall to
protect your characters.
Simplified Chinese: 在场景中点击，放下三个木箱。\n用它们筑墙保护角色。

English source:
Click anywhere on the stage to
place down two barrels.
these will explode when hit by
a weapon.
Simplified Chinese: 在场景中点击，放下两个火药桶。\n受到武器攻击时会爆炸。

English source:
Click on the screen to choose a
path for the seagull to fly.
Then click repeatedly to poop
on the enemy!
Simplified Chinese: 点击屏幕决定海鸥的飞行路线，\n再连续点击，让它攻击敌人！

English source:
Click the mine and drag
with the mouse to aim and
set the power.
It will detonate when
another player moves nearby.
Simplified Chinese: 拖动地雷调整投掷方向和力度。\n其他角色靠近时会引爆。

English source:
Drag the cannon into position
within the circle.
click and drag the pin at the
back to turn the cannon.
release it to fire!
Simplified Chinese: 把大炮拖进圆形范围。\n拖动炮尾调整角度，松开后开火！

English source: Click anywhere in the stage to\ndrop a huge anchor down\nonto enemies!
Simplified Chinese: 点击场景，让巨大的船锚砸向敌人！

English source:
choose an enemy player by
clicking on them. then click
and drag to throw the doll and
watch the enemy helplessly
fly off in the same direction!
Simplified Chinese: 先点击选定敌人，再拖动投出娃娃。\n敌人会朝同一方向飞出去！

English source:
click to send a huge tidal wave
across the bottom of the stage.
It will affect all players it
hits.
Simplified Chinese: 点击后，巨浪席卷场景底部，\n波及途经的所有角色。
